text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Eff-senpai! Good morning.

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text:
Good morning. I'm looking forward to 
working with you today.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Likewise, I look forward to working with 
you! Now... shall we head out to Tokyo 
Racecourse—

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
“—Today's Japan Cup totally feels like an 
all-star showdown! Can't wait for the 
paddock♡ It's gonna be so gorgeous!”

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Right?! Almost all of them are GⅠ 
Umamusume, aren't they? That's crazy~ It's 
way too stacked~!!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, anyone could win this...! 
Sigh... I hope I can get a good spot to 
watch!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... You can really feel the 
anticipation.

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text:
Because it is the 'Japan Cup', after all. 
It is the pinnacle of races... where 
umamusume renowned as the strongest in 
both name and deed gather from home and 
abroad.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Indeed. Epi-senpai is—

text_block_list.name: Race Fan C
text_block_list.text:
—So most people are rooting for 
Gentildonna, huh? Makes sense~. She's 
already won it before, after all. I want 
to see her attempt an unprecedented 
record!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan D
text_block_list.text:
Also, we gotta keep an eye on the girls 
returning from overseas races! Personally, 
I'm curious about Epi too, but... with 
this lineup, yeah～.

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text:
...With so many talented contenders, 
simply gauging things by the outcome alone 
isn't so straightforward, is it?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sure this cheering is reaching 
Epi-senpai too. Even so—"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Tact!! Come watch the Japan Cup!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Eff, I want you to watch me too! Because 
I'm definitely gonna win!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...You are truly strong.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Knowing that she's facing such incredible 
Umamusume... how can she be so confident?

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text: ...Tact-san?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry. I just couldn't help wondering 
what I would do if it were me...

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text:
"...You're a very sensitive and perceptive 
person, aren't you, Tact-san?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Eff-senpai, don't you ever... find 
yourself imagining things like that?

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text:
I will simply...—fulfill the mission 
entrusted to me.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"...You really are strong. Alright, time 
for me to switch gears!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Let's cheer on Epi-senpai with everything 
we've got!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: —Alright! Looking good today too!

Her mental growth has been particularly 
noticeable lately, but... compared to last 
year, the way she moves her body has 
become even more refined.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
The greatest of the era are all gathered 
here today. If I win, then I'm—the 
strongest!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
With the same flawless run as the Kikuka 
Sho, I will bestow destiny upon everyone!!

Aiming for a flawless run last summer was 
because she was still immature, and needed 
to control her fighting spirit first.

However, the way she is now... Having 
grown both in mind and body, perhaps she 
can achieve the running she dreamed of 
back then. In other words—
choice_data_list: ...No, you can let completely loose today.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
choice_data_list: Let's go wild without losing control.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: What?! What the heck is that?!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: "Sounds fascinating!! Tell me more!!"
choice_data_list:
You have to run all the way through while 
keeping your momentum.

You run all the way through while 
maintaining your propulsion.

text_block_list.text:
"She won't lose control spurred on by the 
voice of fate anymore. Because she knows 
that voice is none other than her own true 
will."

And now, she is at the absolute peak of 
her condition. If she can freely draw out 
the voice of destiny and keep it exploding 
to the rhythm of her body—
choice_data_list: You can win by being truest to yourself!

You can win this—in the truest, most 
amazing way that's uniquely you!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: !! True to myself...

Seeing Epiphaneia true to herself, 
unleashing all that overflowing power with 
everything she's got... Everyone is sure 
to be drawn to her.
—Just as I once did.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
...Ahaha!! Ah, that's absolutely 
fantastic!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's show everyone! That the 
'me' you love—is the absolute strongest!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
“—Golshi-san may not be here, but there's 
another opponent we must be just as wary 
of...!”

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ah~, Epi? Yeah, she's on an insane roll 
right now. In all kinds of ways.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
That's right! We must watch out for 
Epi-san going out of control—and counter 
the noble lady's onslaught!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —Good day, Epi.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations on the Tenno Sho (Autumn). 
However... I cannot yield this Japan Cup 
to you as well.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
On my pride as a lady— I shall run you 
down from behind.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
...Otherwise, one has no right to stand on 
the turf.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: ...Gentil.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
You've got your own resolve too, don't 
you! I can tell, I feel it—because it's 
destiny!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I want to help fulfill your feelings too! 
But...—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Epi-san...! Do your best...!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I've got reasons I can't afford to lose, 
too!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"There are kids I want to show a winning 
back to! So there is no way—I'm going to 
lose!!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
And I'll give you the power to keep 
running true to yourself, too!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: —It's time! Let's get started!
